metadata.change_reason: Generic PRD template: background, SMART goals, in/out scope, behavioral requirements, and SLAs

sections.title: Overview
sections.content_hint: Concise summary of system scope, purpose, and target users

sections.title: Background & Market Context
sections.content_hint: Current user pain points and urgency rationale

sections.title: Project Goals & Metrics
sections.content_hint: Measurable SMART objectives and success KPIs

sections.title: Scope & Non-Goals
sections.content_hint: Deliverables in scope and explicit justified scope exclusions

sections.title: DO NOT CHANGE Invariants
sections.content_hint: Pre-existing system invariants and architectural constraints that must be preserved

sections.title: Functional Requirements
sections.content_hint: Modular feature blocks with item anchors, implements links, and RFC 2119 keywords

sections.title: Non-Functional Requirements
sections.content_hint: Performance, capacity, security, and compliance quantified targets

sections.title: Dependencies & Constraints
sections.content_hint: Upstream systems, third-party services, and compliance constraints

sections.title: Risks & Assumptions
sections.content_hint: Identified technical and product risks with mitigations
